newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco buys 43,500T vegoil at $541-$543/tonne C&F.
newsitem.headline: Morocco buys 43,500T vegoil at $541-$543/tonne C&F.

text.p: Morocco purchased 43,500 tonnes of vegetable oil at between $541 and $543 per tonne C&F for delivery in the December-February period, a spokesman at the Casablanca-based Bureau des Approvisionnements en Huile Alimentaire (BUR-APPRO) said on Monday.
A first lot of 12,000 tonnes was purchased at $541 per tonne C&F for arrival January 1-15, 1997.
A second lot of 13,500 tonnes was bought at $541 per tonne C&F for delivery by end-January 1997.
A third lot of 18,000 tonnes was purchased at $543 per tonne C&F for delivery in first half February 1997, the bureau said.
These quantities were purchased from German trader Toepfer and will be delivered at Casablanca port, it said.
The market was told on Friday that Morocco had also purchased 54,000 tonnes of vegetable oil at $532.5 per tonne C&F for delivery between November 1 and December 16, 1996, the bureau said.
The quantities were purchased from Cargill, it added.
